title: Relocate contributor and sizing guidance from the README into canonical docs homes
body:
Part of the `readme-lp-restructure` roadmap (#1580).

## Background

The root README currently carries guidance whose canonical home is a
docs page or the contributing guide. A follow-up issue in this roadmap
replaces the README with a short landing page that no longer contains
this content, so it must exist at its destinations first — otherwise
the rewrite would remove it from the default branch entirely.

This issue only **adds** content to destination files. It does not
touch `README.md` / `README.ja.md`; the rewrite issue owns those.

Destination facts verified at authoring time (2026-07-22):

- `docs/getting-started.md` and `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` are
  generated mirrors: the canonical sources are
  `idd-template/docs/getting-started.md` and
  `idd-template/docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` (exact `syncPairs` in
  `audit/sync-manifest.json`). Edit the `idd-template/docs/` side and
  regenerate.
- `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md` / `.ja.md` / `.zh.md` are hand-maintained
  (no sync pair) and currently contain a single numbered list under
  the H1 with no `##` sections. **Maintainer approval**: the
  repository owner explicitly approved editing these community
  documents for this change in the authoring session on 2026-07-22.
- The remaining README sections slated for removal need **no**
  relocation — their content already exists verbatim or richer at:
  the loop-engineering table in
  `docs/concepts.md#idd-as-loop-engineering`, the byte-budget table in
  `docs/policy-constants.md` (Runtime Instruction Size and Bundle
  Budgets), the merge-policy trio in `docs/customization.md`, and the
  forced-handoff helpers in `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` (Operator
  forced-handoff helpers). Do not duplicate them anywhere.

## Proposed change

Make the following three additions, using the exact text given below.

### 1. Contributor pnpm baseline -> `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md` (three languages)

Append the following section to the **end** of
`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md` (after the numbered list, separated by one
blank line):

````markdown
## Local development tooling

This repository uses a project-local pnpm baseline and Husky hooks so
contributors and autopilot runs can enforce the minimum lint gate
before commit. Template adopters do not need pnpm — use your project's
existing tooling instead (see
[Tooling boundary](../docs/customization.md#tooling-boundary)).

Requires Node.js `^22.22.2 || >=24.2.0` (this repository's `engines`
floor in `package.json`).

```sh
corepack enable
pnpm install
pnpm run lint
pnpm run test
```

The pre-commit hook runs a fast, commit-safe subset
(`pnpm run lint:precommit`: Biome, dprint, and markdownlint); the full
`pnpm run lint:minimum` suite runs in CI. The commit message hook
enforces Conventional Commits through commitlint.

When you edit canonical source files in `idd-template/`, run
`pnpm run docs:sync` to propagate the changes to all mirrored
artifacts.
````

Append the following section to the **end** of
`.github/CONTRIBUTING.ja.md`:

````markdown

このリポジトリには project-local の pnpm 基盤と Husky hook があり、

強制できます。テンプレートの採用者は pnpm を必要としません —
プロジェクト既存のツールを使ってください(詳細は
[Tooling boundary](../docs/customization.md#tooling-boundary))。

Node.js `^22.22.2 || >=24.2.0`(このリポジトリの `package.json` が
定める `engines` の下限)が必要です。

```sh
corepack enable
pnpm install
pnpm run lint
pnpm run test
```

pre-commit hook は高速・コミット安全なサブセット
(`pnpm run lint:precommit`: Biome・dprint・markdownlint)を実行し、
完全な `pnpm run lint:minimum` スイートは CI で実行されます。
commit-msg hook は commitlint により Conventional Commits を検証します。

`idd-template/` 配下の正規ソースファイルを編集したときは、
`pnpm run docs:sync` を実行して、すべてのミラーアーティファクトへ

````

Append the following section to the **end** of
`.github/CONTRIBUTING.zh.md`:

````markdown
## 本地开发工具

本仓库使用 project-local 的 pnpm 基础和 Husky 钩子,使贡献者和
autopilot 运行能够在提交前强制执行最低限度的 lint 门槛。模板的采用者
不需要 pnpm — 请使用你的项目现有的工具(详见
[Tooling boundary](../docs/customization.md#tooling-boundary))。

需要 Node.js `^22.22.2 || >=24.2.0`(本仓库 `package.json` 中定义的

```sh

pnpm install
pnpm run lint

```

pre-commit 钩子运行快速且提交安全的子集
(`pnpm run lint:precommit`: Biome、dprint 和 markdownlint);完整的
`pnpm run lint:minimum` 套件在 CI 中运行。commit-msg 钩子通过

编辑 `idd-template/` 下的规范源文件后,请运行 `pnpm run docs:sync`
````

### 2. IDD doctor guidance -> `idd-template/docs/getting-started.md`

Insert the following subsection at the **end of the
`## 1. Import the Template` section** (immediately before the
`## 2. Choose the Review Policy` heading), then regenerate the mirror:

````markdown
### Validate the import with IDD doctor (optional)

After importing IDD, run the doctor script once in a repository that
has the helper installed to catch common setup drift:

```sh
node scripts/idd-doctor.mjs
```

The report checks core IDD file presence, unresolved placeholders,
marker-prefix consistency, command-table sanity, and (when `gh` access
is available) branch-protection and required-check signals.
````

### 3. Helper-runtime footprint guidance -> `idd-template/docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`

Insert the following subsection at the **end of the
`## Import-Time Selection Order` section** (immediately before the
`## Profile Wiring Surface` heading), then regenerate the mirror:

````markdown
### Practical footprint guidance

Practical loop pressure depends on the helper runtime choice:

- Prefer helper runtime support when you want lower day-to-day
  context pressure in the E/F phases: helper commands collect
  evidence, while merge and mutation decisions still follow the
  written gates.
- Keep `instructions-only` when your repository avoids Node.js or
  helper tooling, or your team prefers a fully manual
  shell/`gh`/`jq` path.
- Expect variance either way: local policy additions, local docs, and
  extra repository instructions can make your practical footprint
  smaller or larger than the idd-skill source repository.
````

After both `idd-template/docs/` edits, run
`node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --apply` (or `pnpm run docs:sync`) so the
generated `docs/getting-started.md` and `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`
mirrors update in the same commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.github/CONTRIBUTING.ja.md`, and
      `.github/CONTRIBUTING.zh.md` each end with the new
      "Local development tooling" section exactly as specified for
      their language.
- [ ] `idd-template/docs/getting-started.md` contains the
      "Validate the import with IDD doctor (optional)" subsection at
      the end of section 1, and the generated
      `docs/getting-started.md` mirror matches it byte-for-byte.
- [ ] `idd-template/docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` contains the
      "Practical footprint guidance" subsection at the end of the
      Import-Time Selection Order section, and the generated
      `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` mirror matches it byte-for-byte.
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.ja.md` are untouched by this change.
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm run lint` passes (markdownlint covers the edited
      CONTRIBUTING and docs files).

---

_Autopilot suitability: 5 / 5 -- fully specified verbatim additions
with mechanical sync and lint verification._
